prompt:
Update sections/store-info-hours.liquid so that the opening-hours list is formatted and grouped. Keep the {% schema %}...{% endschema %} block byte-for-byte unchanged. Inputs. The template may read only these variables, all nested under the top-level object `section`: - section.settings.store_name: string or null. - section.settings.address: string or null. - section.blocks: array, possibly empty. Each block is {"settings": {...}} with: - block.settings.day: string, never null. - block.settings.opens: integer minutes after midnight (0-1439), or null. - block.settings.closes: integer minutes after midnight (0-1439), or null. Output must be compact, with no whitespace or newlines between tags except where stated. Elements appear in this order: 1.
2.

NAME

. NAME is store_name escaped with the escape filter; null outputs an empty h2. 3.

ADDR

. ADDR is address escaped; null outputs an empty p. 4. Hours list. Only output it if section.blocks is non-empty:
    GROUPS
. 5. Close with
. Time text for each block: - The block is closed if opens is null, closes is null, or closes <= opens. A closed block's time text is exactly Closed. - Otherwise the time text is OPEN - CLOSE: a space, a hyphen and a space between the two times. - Each time is formatted in 12-hour form H:MM AM or H:MM PM: - The hour has no leading zero. - Minutes are always two digits. - 0:xx becomes 12:xx AM, 1-11 are AM, 12:xx becomes 12:xx PM, and 13-23 become 1-11 PM. - Examples: 0 -> 12:00 AM, 545 -> 9:05 AM, 725 -> 12:05 PM, 1081 -> 6:01 PM. Grouping: - Walk the blocks in order. Consecutive blocks whose time text is identical form one group. Non-adjacent blocks with the same text form separate groups. - Each group outputs
  • DAYS TIME
    • . There is exactly one space between the two spans. - DAYS is the escaped day of the group's single block when the group contains exactly one block. - When the group contains two or more blocks, DAYS is FIRST-LAST: the escaped day of the first and of the last block, joined by a hyphen with no spaces. This applies even if the two day names are equal. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Preserve the entire schema block byte-for-byte. Change only sections/store-info-hours.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
